text:
erin: Flagging Azure marketplace invoice INV-2026-0610 for reseller BrightLane. Looks like a seat undercount (they were charged $8,950 but expected $11,200). @sam can you pull the settlement and tell me if this is a marketplace-side deduction or our mapping?

sam: pulling settlement now. any settlement id?

azure-marketplace-bot: Alert: Adjustment recorded for account 'brightlane-reseller' on invoice INV-2026-0610. Adjustment ID: AZADJ-7719. Type: Usage undercount (negative revenue adjustment).

erin: CSV export snippet from portal (redacted):

```
invoice_id,account,sku,amount,reason
INV-2026-0610,brightlane-reseller,rdw-seat-month,8950.00,settlement: seats billed 220 vs expected 275
```

sam: that shows billed seats 220. our channel-sync log for May 31 has an event `reseller_sync:brightlane / seats:275` though. grep: `sync_ts:1717142400 / seats_reported:275`. attaching to JIRA FIN-2533.

lucas: curious — did BrightLane submit a usage adjustment to Azure? sometimes partners push a corrected usage and Azure reconciles down. do we have their ticket?

erin: BrightLane opened a case saying they saw a duplicate deprovision event in our webhook on May 30. they asked for a correction. case ref BL-845. I've added their message to FIN-2533.

sam: ok, path forward: 1) Confirm if webhook duplication caused 55-seat deprovision. 2) If yes, request Azure adjustment reversal or push manifest to correct billed quantity. 3) Get Sr Finance Manager signoff for posting a -$2,250 revenue correction.

lucas: estimate: -$2.25k revenue this month, impact to ARR is minimal but include in month close memo.

erin: created one-pager with timeline, logs, and proposed GL entry (4120 - Partner Adjustments). JIRA FIN-2533: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-2533. tagging sam for verification.

sam: verified logs, duplication confirmed. requesting approval.

erin: pinging vp_finance for approval. :mailbox_with_mail:

azure-marketplace-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled in 48h for Adjustment AZADJ-7719 to confirm approval and payout reconciliation.
__notes: Slack thread in finance about an Azure marketplace reseller undercount (BrightLane). Contains CSV snippet, logs reference, JIRA ticket, and next steps for approval and reconciliation.
